purpose: Gaia DR3 astrometric positions for confirmed exoplanet host stars and explicitly documented named reference stars in an exact 300-light-year geometric volume around TRAPPIST-1.

gaia_kinematics_enrichment.selection: Exact source_id values from gaia-dr3-confirmed-exoplanet-hosts-trappist-1-300ly.csv; the enrichment query returns one Gaia row for each focused catalog row.

volume.selection_rule: Exact Euclidean separation in reciprocal-parallax ICRS Cartesian coordinates at J2016.0 is less than or equal to radius_parsecs.

nasa_exoplanet_archive.adql: SELECT hostname,gaia_dr3_id,pl_name,discoverymethod,disc_year,sy_dist,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbeccen FROM pscomppars WHERE gaia_dr3_id IS NOT NULL AND sy_dist <= 104.44733155111514
nasa_exoplanet_archive.broad_containment_rule: sy_dist is limited to the preliminary Solar-System-barycentric containment radius only; final membership is determined by the Gaia Cartesian TRAPPIST-1 separation.

join.method: Exact match between Gaia DR3 source_id and NASA gaia_dr3_id after removal of the literal prefix 'Gaia DR3 '.

known_planetary_system_diameter.definition: Twice the largest known planetary apoastron: 2 × max[a × (1 + e)].
known_planetary_system_diameter.inclusion_rule: At least one confirmed planet must have finite pl_orbsmax > 0 and 0 <= pl_orbeccen < 1.

light_second_conversion.definition: IAU-defined astronomical unit divided by the SI-defined speed of light.

limitations: PSCompPars is used only for confirmed exoplanet records; candidates are not included.
The reported diameter is the known planetary-orbit extent only. It excludes stellar companions, debris disks, and planets without the required reported elements.
This is a reciprocal-parallax display selection, not a probabilistic distance-selected census.
No debris-belt-only systems are included without a separately citable detection catalog and unambiguous Gaia DR3 match.
